# Proverbs 9 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 9:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | She-has-slaughtered her-slaughter; she-has-mixed her-wine; also she-has-set her-table. |
| LOGOS | She has slaughtered her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table. |
| PNEUMA | She's prepared a feast — the meat is cooked, the wine is mixed, and the table is set. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | She-has-sent-out her-maidens; she-calls upon [the]-heights-of [the]-summits-of [the]-city: |
| LOGOS | She has sent out her young women to call from the highest points of the city, |
| PNEUMA | She sends her servants out to call from the highest point in the city: |

## 9:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Forsake simple-ones and-live, and-walk in-[the]-way-of understanding." |
| LOGOS | Leave your simple ways, and live, and walk in the way of insight." |
| PNEUMA | Walk away from ignorance — choose to live! Take the road that leads to real understanding." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 9:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | One-correcting a-scoffer takes for-himself shame, and-one-rebuking a-wicked-one — his-blemish. |
| LOGOS | Whoever corrects a scoffer gets himself abuse, and he who reproves a wicked man incurs injury. |
| PNEUMA | If you try to correct someone who mocks, you'll just get insulted. Confront a wicked person, and you'll get hurt. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 9:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-rebuke a-scoffer lest he-hate-you; rebuke a-wise-man and-he-will-love-you. |
| LOGOS | Do not reprove a scoffer, or he will hate you; reprove a wise man, and he will love you. |
| PNEUMA | Don't waste your energy correcting a mocker — they'll only hate you for it. But correct a wise person, and they'll thank you. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 9:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Give to-a-wise-man and-he-will-be-yet-wiser; inform a-righteous-man and-he-will-increase learning. |
| LOGOS | Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser; teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning. |
| PNEUMA | Teach a wise person, and they become wiser. Show a good person something new, and they grow even more. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
